negative_reviews.author: linda walker
negative_reviews.text: Sat in the outside area as my daughter needs gluten free and couldn't eat here. Enjoyed my food. Portions were large.

negative_reviews.author: Wai-Khin Hoi
negative_reviews.text: Had dinner at the restaurant on 26 May 26. Served by Monica. She gave the us the feeling, she was rushing through taking many orders but the restaurant was not full. We didn't dare to make charges to the orders as she seems to be rushing off. There was no complimentary water given until we asked for it. The ramen served was average and after we finished our meal, she just put the tab on the table. When we paid, a 10% was added. Try asking others to take orders when you are there or maybe today will become better.
